name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a royalty and streaming company focused exclusively on precious metal assets in Nevada, one of the world's premier mining jurisdictions. The company acquires royalties on producing, pre-production, and exploration-stage properties, packages them, and manages the portfolio to generate future cash flow. Its flagship asset is the Olinghouse Project, a gold property located approximately 30 miles east of Reno, Nevada.
